notablePrerequisites:
Vampirism attached to any creature you control except Ruthless Ripper.
You have at least one additional black card in hand.
description:
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face-up and triggering its ability.
Ruthless Ripper dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Ruthless Ripper trigger from step 1, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat.
